text_block_list.text: While taking a stroll in the park on my day off...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pigyaaah!?
C-Could this be... the first circle of Hell!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A savior in hell! An omen met by Trainer-san!!
Please saaaave meee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I dozed off on a bench taking a nap
and just woke up! And then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"A crow cawed four times overhead...!!
That's definitely an omen of bad luck!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, my mother always said that too!
"It's dangerous, so...
be home before the crows start cawing!"
Confronted by an unexpected omen of bad luck, Matikanefukukitaru seemed to have completely lost all her energy...
